top_signals.title: Bessent 'Wants To Win', Drive Yields Lower: Brill
top_signals.summary:
Matt Brill, head of North American investment grade credit at Invesco, and Meghan Robson, head of US credit strategy at BNP Paribas, joins Michael McKee on "Bloomberg Real Yield." They discuss Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's focus on driving yields lower.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
